situation: Your friend is sitting next to you and keeps talking, but you want to focus on the lecture and take notes. What would you say to him?
answer: "Hey, I 'm really trying to focus on the lecture so I can take good notes. Would you mind saving the story for after class? Thanks. "
situation_zh: 你的朋友坐在你旁边，一直在说话，但你想专注于讲座并记笔记。你会对他说什么？
answer_zh: “嘿，我真的很想集中精力听课，这样我就可以做好笔记。你介意把这个故事留到课后吗？谢谢。”

situation: You just told your friend that your exam is scheduled for 3 p.m. tomorrow afternoon. But you’ve just found out that you made a mistake—the exam is actually at 2 p.m. this afternoon. You need to call your friend immediately to correct this information. What would you say?
answer: "Hi, I need to correct something urgent about the exam. I told you it 's at 3 p.m. tomorrow, but that's wrong. I just found out it's actually at 2 p.m. today—so in just a few hours. Please ignore my earlier message and make sure you 're prepared for the earlier time. Sorry for the confusion and the short notice! "
situation_zh: 您刚刚告诉您的朋友您的考试安排在下午 3 点。明天下午。但你刚刚发现自己犯了一个错误——考试实际上是在下午 2 点。今天下午。您需要立即致电您的朋友以更正此信息。你会说什么？
answer_zh: “嗨，我需要纠正一些有关考试的紧急信息。我告诉过你明天下午 3 点，但那是错误的。我刚刚发现实际上是今天下午 2 点，所以就在几个小时内。请忽略我之前的消息，并确保您为较早的时间做​​好准备。对于造成的混乱和仓促的通知，我们深表歉意！”

title_en: Request to Switch Rooms for Debating Club
title_zh: 请求更换辩论俱乐部房
situation: You 're organizing a debating club, but the room you booked is too small. There happens to be a larger room next door, but there are students studying inside. If you want to switch rooms, what would you say to those students?
answer: Excuse me, dear fellow students. We booked this small room for our debating club, but it’s too cramped for our activity. We noticed your larger room next door. Would you mind switching rooms with us? We’ll help move your stuﬀ promptly and ensure no disturbance. We’d be extremely grateful for your kindness.
situation_zh: 您正在组织一个辩论俱乐部，但您预订的房间太小。隔壁正好有一个比较大的房间，但是里面有学生在学习。如果你想换房间，你会对那些学生说什么？
answer_zh: 对不起，亲爱的同学们。我们为辩论俱乐部预订了这个小房间，但对于我们的活动来说太局促了。我们注意到隔壁您的房间较大。您介意和我们换房间吗？我们将帮助您及时搬运物品并确保不会受到干扰。我们将非常感谢您的好意。

situation: You are on your way to campus to deliver a presentation when a fallen tree blocks the road, preventing you from arriving on time. You call your professor to ask if it would be possible to reschedule your presentation for later, or allow another student to present ﬁrst. What would you say?
answer: Hi professor, sorry to bother you. A fallen tree is blocking my way to campus, so I’ll be late for the presentation. Could I reschedule it to later, or let another student go ﬁrst? Thanks for your understanding!
situation_zh: 您正在前往校园发表演讲的路上，一棵倒下的树挡住了道路，使您无法准时到达。你打电话给你的教授，询问是否可以重新安排你的演讲时间，或者允许其他学生先演讲。你会说什么？
answer_zh: 教授您好，很抱歉打扰您。一棵倒下的树挡住了我去校园的路，所以我的演讲会迟到。我可以重新安排到晚些时候，或者让另一个学生先去吗？感谢您的理解！

situation: Your friend frequently skips classes, arrives late, leaves early, and does not submit assignments on time. What advice would you give them?
answer: Hey, I’m a bit worried about you skipping classes and missing deadlines. Try to set a daily schedule, attend lectures on time, and ﬁnish assignments step by step. Small changes will help you catch up soon!
situation_zh: 你的朋友经常逃课、迟到、早退、不按时提交作业。你会给他们什么建议？
answer_zh: 嘿，我有点担心你逃课和错过最后期限。尝试制定每天的时间表，按时听课，按部就班地完成作业。小小的改变将帮助你很快赶上！

situation: When you arrived at the usual classroom where you often have class, you saw a notice that said "Computer broken, need to move to a diﬀerent classroom. " However, because you were late today, by the time you got there, the other students had already moved to the other classroom. So you had to call a classmate and ask them to tell you how to get to the new classroom. What would you say?
answer: Hi, it 's Your Name. I 'm at our regular classroom and just saw the note saying we moved. Could you please tell me where the new classroom is? If you have a moment, could you also give me quick directions or the room number? Thank you!
situation_zh: 当你到达常上课的教室时，看到一张告示，上面写着“电脑坏了，需要搬到其他教室。”然而，因为你今天迟到了，等你到了那里，其他学生已经搬到另一个教室了。所以你必须打电话给同学，让他们告诉你如何去新教室。你会说什么？
answer_zh: 嗨，这是你的名字。我在我们的普通教室，刚刚看到纸条说我们搬家了。你能告诉我新教室在哪里吗？如果您有时间，能给我快速路线或房间号吗？谢谢你！

situation: You have a deadline next week for a paper to submit, but your computer is broken, so you need more time to ﬁnish the paper. What would you say to your professor if you want to ask for a week 's extension?
answer: Hello Professor, I 'm writing to respectfully request a one-week extension for the upcoming paper. Unfortunately, my computer has broken down, which has delayed my progress signiﬁcantly. I am working to resolve the issue, but I would need a bit more time to complete the assignment properly. Would it be possible to submit it by next Friday? Thank you for your understanding.
situation_zh: 下周是你提交论文的最后期限，但你的电脑坏了，所以你需要更多时间来完成论文。如果你想请求延长一周，你会对你的教授说什么？
answer_zh: 教授您好，我写信是为了尊敬地请求将即将发表的论文延长一周。不幸的是，我的电脑坏了，这严重耽误了我的进度。我正在努力解决该问题，但我需要更多时间才能正确完成作业。下周五之前可以提交吗？感谢您的理解。

situation: You are doing a weekend hiking trip with your friends. However, you 've noticed one of them are not wearing proper shoes that may lead to discomfort or injuries during the hike. What would you say to him?
answer: Hey, just wanted to check something with you. I noticed your shoes might not be the best ﬁt for the hike we have planned—some parts of the trail can be pretty rough or slippery. Wearing shoes with good grip and support could really help keep you comfortable and prevent any slips or injuries. Do you have a pair of hiking or sturdy sneakers you could bring along for safety?
situation_zh: 您正在与朋友一起进行周末徒步旅行。然而，您注意到其中一位没有穿合适的鞋子，这可能会导致徒步旅行期间感到不适或受伤。你会对他说什么？
answer_zh: 嘿，我只是想跟你确认一下事情。我注意到你的鞋子可能不太适合我们计划的徒步旅行——小径的某些部分可能非常崎岖或湿滑。穿着具有良好抓地力和支撑力的鞋子确实可以帮助您保持舒适并防止滑倒或受伤。为了安全起见，您有一双可以携带的徒步鞋或坚固的运动鞋吗？

situation: You think the food served in the school cafeteria is not healthy enough. You want to put forward some suggestions to the staﬀ to improve it. What would you say?
answer: Hello, I 'd like to share some feedback regarding the food options in the cafeteria. I believe there is room to make them healthier. It would be great if we could have more fresh fruits, vegetables, and whole-grain choices available daily. Oﬀering grilled or baked items instead of fried ones could also make a big diﬀerence. Thank you for considering my suggestions.
situation_zh: 你认为学校食堂提供的食物不够健康。您想向员工提出一些改进建议。你会说什么？
answer_zh: 您好，我想分享一些有关自助餐厅食物选择的反馈。我相信有空间让他们更健康。如果我们每天能有更多的新鲜水果、蔬菜和全麦选择，那就太好了。提供烧烤或烘焙食品而不是油炸食品也可能会产生很大的不同。感谢您考虑我的建议。

situation: You attended a lecture earlier today, but later realized that you lost the notebook where you had written all your notes. Your friend, who also attended the lecture, took very clear and detailed notes. You decide to ask her if she would be willing to lend you her notes to help you catch up. What would you say?
answer: Hi, I 'm really sorry to bother you, but I just realized I lost my notebook with all my notes from today 's lecture. I know you take really clear notes. Would it be possible to borrow yours so I can catch up? I 'll return them as soon as possible.
situation_zh: 您今天早些时候参加了一场讲座，但后来意识到您丢失了写下所有笔记的笔记本。你的朋友也参加了讲座，他的笔记非常清晰详细。你决定问她是否愿意借给你她的笔记来帮助你跟上进度。你会说什么？
answer_zh: 你好，我很抱歉打扰你，但我刚刚意识到我丢失了我的笔记本，里面有今天讲座的所有笔记。我知道你的笔记非常清晰。可以借用你的吗，这样我就可以赶上？我会尽快归还它们。

title_zh: 从图书馆切换到咖啡馆
situation: You arranged to go to the library with your friend to use the study room, but you just found out that the study room is double booked. You want to suggest meeting at a cafe instead. What would you say to your friend?
answer: Hi, I just found out the library study room is double booked. How about we meet at the cafe down the street? It’s cozy and perfect for our study session. Let me know if that works!
situation_zh: 你约好和朋友去图书馆使用自习室，但你刚刚发现自习室被重复预订了。您想建议在咖啡馆见面。你会对你的朋友说什么？
answer_zh: 你好，我刚刚发现图书馆自习室被重复预订了。我们在街边的咖啡馆见面怎么样？这里非常舒适，非常适合我们的学习。让我知道这是否有效！

title_en: Give Speech Advice for a Friend
situation: Your friend is going to give a speech and feels really nervous about it. You want to give him/her some advice to calm down. What would you say to your friend?
answer: Hey, take it easy! Just focus on your speech content instead of the audience’s eyes. Breathe slowly before starting—it’ll calm your nerves. You’ve practiced a lot, so trust yourself. I’m sure you’ll do great!
situation_zh: 你的朋友要发表演讲，对此感到非常紧张。你想给他/她一些建议，让他/她冷静下来。你会对你的朋友说什么？
answer_zh: 嘿，放轻松！只需关注演讲内容而不是听众的眼睛。开始之前缓慢呼吸——这会让你的神经平静下来。 You’ve practiced a lot, so trust yourself.我相信你会做得很好！

situation: Your roommate Tom has agreed to be interviewed by you for a course assignment. However, he is out right now. You want to leave him a note to thank him, and also inform him that the interview will take place on Wednesday afternoon and last for about an hour. What would you say in the note?
answer: Hey Tom! I 'd like to express gratitude to you! Thanks much for agreeing to my interview for the course assignment. Just a reminder that the interview will be on Wednesday afternoon and will last for an hour. Please get prepared before the interview! See you then!
situation_zh: 您的室友汤姆同意接受您的课程作业面试。不过，他现在已经出去了。你想给他留一张纸条来感谢他，并告诉他面试将在周三下午进行，持续大约一个小时。你会在笔记中说什么？
answer_zh: 嘿汤姆！我谨向您表示感谢！非常感谢您同意我的课程作业面试。请注意，面试将于周三下午进行，持续一个小时。请面试前做好准备！到时候见！

situation: You can 't ﬁnd your class notes, but you need them to ﬁnish your assignments. Your friend 's notes are very good. You want to borrow hers. How would you tell her?
answer: Hey, I’m in a bit of a bind , I can’t ﬁnd my class notes anywhere and I really need them to ﬁnish my assignment. I remember yours are always so clear and thorough. Would it be okay if I borrowed them for a day or two? I’ll take good care of them and get them back to you as soon as I’m done.
situation_zh: 您找不到课堂笔记，但您需要它们来完成作业。你朋友的笔记写得很好。你想借她的。你会怎样告诉她？
answer_zh: 嘿，我有点困惑，我在任何地方都找不到我的课堂笔记，我真的需要它们来完成我的作业。我记得你的总是那么清晰、透彻。如果我借用一两天可以吗？我会好好照顾它们，完成后立即还给你。

title_en: Borrow Friend’s Lecture Notes for Exam
situation: You missed the lecture last week and you know the information will be on the exam next week. Your friend takes very good notes during lectures. You want to get his notes from him so that you can use them to prepare. What do you say to him?
answer: Hi, I hope you 're doing well! I just realized I missed last week 's lecture, and I heard the content will be on next week 's exam. You always take such detailed notes in class, so I was wondering if I could borrow your notes to review? It would really help me prepare and make sure I don’t miss any key points. I can pick them up from you whenever it’s convenient, or you could send me a photo if that’s easier. Thanks so much—you’re a lifesaver!
situation_zh: 您错过了上周的讲座，并且您知道这些信息将出现在下周的考试中。你的朋友在讲座中记下了很好的笔记。你想从他那里得到他的笔记，以便你可以用它们来准备。你对他说什么？
answer_zh: 嗨，我希望你一切都好！我刚刚意识到我错过了上周的讲座，而且我听说内容将在下周的考试中出现。你上课总是记这么详细的笔记，我想能借你的笔记复习一下吗？这确实可以帮助我做好准备并确保我不会错过任何关键点。我可以在方便的时候从你那里取它们，或者如果更方便的话你可以给我发一张照片。非常感谢——你是我的救星！

situation: Your computer is broken and you can’t attend the online class. How should you tell your professor?
answer: Hi! I would like to discuss an issue we have encountered with my absence from the online class. The background is that my computer is broken and I can’t attend the online class. In the situation, what I can think of is to ask if you can share the class recording. Besides, another thing that comes to my mind is to consult you about the homework of the course.
situation_zh: 你的电脑坏了，无法参加网课。你应该如何告诉你的教授？
answer_zh: 你好！我想讨论一下我缺席网课时遇到的一个问题。背景是我的电脑坏了，无法参加网课。在这种情况下，我能想到的就是问你是否可以分享一下课堂录音。另外，我想到的另一件事就是向您请教课程的作业。

situation: You’ve been given a deadline for an assignment, but due to a personal emergency, you need more time to ﬁnish it. How would you approach your professor to request an extension and ensure the situation is handled appropriately? What would you say?
answer: Professor, I 'm writing to respectfully request an extension for the assignment due on . A personal emergency has disrupted my schedule. Could I possibly submit it by ? This would allow me to deliver the quality work I aim for. Thank you for your consideration.
situation_zh: 您已收到作业的截止日期，但由于个人紧急情况，您需要更多时间来完成它。您将如何联系您的教授请求延期并确保情况得到适当处理？你会说什么？
answer_zh: 教授，我写信是为了恭敬地请求延长 9 日到期的作业。个人紧急情况打乱了我的日程安排。我可以在 之前提交吗？这将使我能够交付我想要的高质量工作。感谢您的考虑。

situation: You have to return a book to your friend, but when you get to school you realize you have forgotten to bring it. Your friend really needs it today. What will you say to your friend?
answer: Hey, I 'm so sorry, but I 've just realized that I forgot your book at home. I know you really need it today, so here 's what I can do: I can call my parents and see if they can bring it over during their lunch break. If that doesn 't work, I can quickly go home during the lunch break to get it for you. Again, I 'm really sorry about this.
situation_zh: 你必须把一本书还给你的朋友，但当你到达学校时，你发现你忘了带它。你的朋友今天确实需要它。你会对你的朋友说什么？
answer_zh: 嘿，很抱歉，我刚刚意识到我把你的书忘在家里了。我知道你今天确实需要它，所以我能做的就是：我可以给我的父母打电话，看看他们是否可以在午休时间把它带过来。如果不行的话，我可以趁午休时间赶紧回家给你拿。再次，我对此感到非常抱歉。

situation: Your ﬂatmates are holding a party with loud music in their room at night, which is too noisy and inﬂuences your sleep, but you have an important exam early tomorrow morning. What should you say to them?
answer: Hi guys, I hope you 're having a great time at the party. It sounds really fun. However, I have a very important exam early tomorrow morning that I must be well-rested for. The loud music is making it impossible for me to sleep, and I 'm starting to feel quite anxious about my exam. So, I was wondering if you could possibly lower the volume of the music? That would help me a lot. Alternatively, if you could move the party to the common area, that might also work. I really appreciate your understanding. Thank you so much, and enjoy the rest of your night!
situation_zh: 你的室友晚上在房间里开派对，音乐很吵，太吵了，影响你的睡眠，而你明天一早就有重要的考试。你应该对他们说什么？
answer_zh: 嗨，大家好，我希望你们在聚会上玩得开心。听起来真的很有趣。不过，明天一早我有一场非常重要的考试，我必须好好休息。吵闹的音乐让我无法入睡，我开始对考试感到非常焦虑。所以我想知道你是否可以降低音乐的音量？这对我有很大帮助。或者，如果您可以将聚会转移到公共区域，这也可能有效。我非常感谢您的理解。非常感谢您，祝您度过愉快的夜晚！

situation: You wrote an assignment, consulted your tutor, and asked them for some feedback on your work. What would you say to him?
answer: Hi sir, I’ve just ﬁnished drafting my assignment and was wondering if you could spare a moment to give me some feedback? I’d really value your thoughts on my structure and arguments to make sure I’m on the right track. Thanks so much for your help!
situation_zh: 你写了一份作业，咨询了你的导师，并要求他们对你的工作提供一些反馈。你会对他说什么？
answer_zh: 你好，先生，我刚刚完成了作业的起草，想知道你是否能抽出一点时间给我一些反馈？我非常重视您对我的结构和论点的想法，以确保我走在正确的轨道上。非常感谢您的帮助！

situation: Your ﬂatmate doesn 't follow the schedule to complete housework. What would you say to him or her?
answer: H, I noticed we agreed on a housework schedule earlier, but lately some tasks haven’t been done on time. Could we chat about it? Maybe adjust the schedule if it’s too tight-keeping things fair would make our place nicer for both of us.
situation_zh: 你的室友没有按照时间表完成家务。你会对他或她说什么？
answer_zh: H，我注意到我们之前约定好了家务日程，但是最近有些任务没有按时完成。我们可以聊聊吗？如果时间安排太紧张，也许调整一下日程安排，保持公平会让我们的地方对我们俩都更好。

situation: Your loan has been delayed, so you can 't pay the full amount of the accommodation fee at once. You have a part-time job, but it 's not enough. You are going to ask the university accommodation oﬃcer for advice. What will you say?
answer: Hello, I 'm writing because my student loan is delayed, so I cannot pay my full accommodation fee. I have a part-time job, but it 's insuﬃcient. Could you please advise me on a possible payment plan until my loan arrives?
situation_zh: 您的贷款已被推迟，因此您无法立即支付全额住宿费。你有一份兼职工作，但这还不够。您将向大学住宿官员寻求建议。你会说什么？
answer_zh: 您好，我写这封信是因为我的学生贷款被推迟，所以我无法支付全额住宿费。我有一份兼职工作，但还不够。在我的贷款到达之前，您能否就可能的付款计划提供建议？

situation: You lent a book to a classmate three weeks ago, and he hasn 't returned it yet. Now, you need the book very much. What would you say to him?
answer: Hey , I hope you’re doing well! I was wondering if you’ve ﬁnished reading the book I lent you three weeks ago. I need it for my studies now, so could you please return it when you get a chance? Thanks a lot!
situation_zh: 三周前你借给一位同学一本书，他还没有归还。现在，你非常需要这本书。你会对他说什么？
answer_zh: 嘿，我希望你一切都好！我想知道你是否已经读完我三周前借给你的那本书了。我现在学习需要它，所以当你有机会时可以归还它吗？多谢！

situation: You are enrolled in Professor Miller 's History course. You 've missed the last three classes because you had to care for a sick family member. You haven 't been able to keep up with the readings or assignments. You approach Professor Miller after class to explain your situation. What would you say?
answer: Professor Miller, may I speak with you? I 've missed classes because I was caring for a sick family member. I apologize for falling behind and would appreciate guidance on catching up. Could you advise which readings and assignments are most critical? I 'm committed to making up the work.
situation_zh: 您已报名参加米勒教授的历史课程。您错过了最后三节课，因为您必须照顾生病的家庭成员。你无法跟上阅读或作业的进度。下课后你向米勒教授解释你的情况。你会说什么？
answer_zh: 米勒教授，我可以和您说话吗？我因为照顾生病的家人而缺课。对于落后，我深表歉意，并希望得到有关赶上的指导。您能建议哪些阅读材料和作业是最重要的吗？我致力于弥补工作。

situation: You are feeling overwhelmed by the upcoming ﬁnal exams and decide to seek advice from a senior student who has successfully navigated them before. You see them in the campus coﬀee shop, take a seat at their table, and introduce yourself. What would you say?
answer: Hi, I 'm Your Name, a second-year student. I 'm feeling quite overwhelmed by ﬁnals and heard you aced them last year. Would you have 10 minutes to share some study strategies? I 'd really appreciate any tips on time management or subject prioritization. Maybe we could chat over coﬀee?
situation_zh: 你对即将到来的期末考试感到不知所措，决定向以前成功通过考试的高年级学生寻求建议。你在校园咖啡馆里看到他们，在他们的桌子旁坐下，然后自我介绍。你会说什么？
answer_zh: 大家好，我是二年级学生《你的名字》。我对决赛感到不知所措，听说你去年取得了好成绩。您能抽出 10 分钟时间来分享一些学习策略吗？我真的很感激任何关于时间管理或主题优先顺序的建议。也许我们可以边喝咖啡边聊天？

situation: You are eating lunch in the university cafeteria. You take a bite of the chicken and realize it 's signiﬁcantly undercooked and still pink inside. You need to speak to one of the cafeteria staﬀ members about this issue. What would you say?
situation_zh: 你正在大学食堂吃午餐。你咬了一口鸡肉，发现它还没有煮熟，里面还是粉红色的。您需要与自助餐厅的一名工作人员讨论这个问题。你会说什么？

situation: You are working on a research paper for one of your classes. You asked a classmate to read your draft and they gave you some helpful comments last week. Now, you see them in the library and want to let them know you appreciated their feedback. What would you say?
answer: Hi ! I just wanted to thank you again for reviewing my draft last week - your comments were incredibly helpful. I 've incorporated several of your suggestions and my paper is much stronger now. I really appreciate you taking the time to help me out. Let me know if I can ever return the favor!
situation_zh: 您正在为您的一门课程撰写研究论文。您请一位同学阅读您的草稿，他们上周给了您一些有用的评论。现在，您在图书馆看到他们，想让他们知道您感谢他们的反馈。你会说什么？
answer_zh: 你好 ！我只是想再次感谢您上周审阅我的草稿 - 您的评论非常有帮助。我已经采纳了您的一些建议，现在我的论文更加有力了。我真的很感谢您抽出时间来帮助我。如果我能回报你的恩情，请告诉我！

title_zh: 报告无人值守的笔记本电脑
situation: You are in the library and notice a student has left their laptop unattended at a table. There are several people nearby, but you are concerned about the laptop 's security. You decide to report it to the security desk which is located near the entrance. What would you say?
answer: Excuse me, I wanted to report an unattended laptop on the second ﬂoor study area. It 's been left alone for over 15 minutes with no one nearby. I 'm concerned about its security but didn 't want to touch it myself. Could you please have someone check on it? Thank you for your help.
situation_zh: 您在图书馆，注意到一名学生将笔记本电脑留在桌子上无人看管。附近有几个人，但您担心笔记本电脑的安全。您决定向位于入口附近的保安服务台报告。你会说什么？
answer_zh: 打扰一下，我想报告二楼学习区有一台无人值守的笔记本电脑。它已被单独放置超过 15 分钟，附近无人。我担心它的安全性，但不想自己碰它。可以请人检查一下吗？感谢您的帮助。

situation: You are in the university 's photography club, but you 've realized you 're overcommitted this semester with your coursework and a part-time job. You need to tell the club president, whom you see in the hallway, that you have to withdraw from the club. What do you say?
answer: Hi , I must regrettably resign from the club. Balancing studies and work has become overwhelming, and I can 't participate properly. I 've valued our time together and hope to rejoin when my schedule allows. Thank you for everything - I 'll return my equipment this week if needed.
situation_zh: 你加入了大学的摄影俱乐部，但你意识到这个学期你的课程作业和兼职工作负担过重。你需要告诉你在走廊里看到的俱乐部主席，你必须退出俱乐部。你怎么说？
answer_zh: 嗨，我必须遗憾地从俱乐部辞职。平衡学习和工作已经变得难以承受，我无法正常参与。我很珍惜我们在一起的时间，并希望在我的日程允许的情况下重新加入。谢谢你们所做的一切 - 如果需要的话，我会在本周归还我的设备。

situation: You are in the campus library working on an urgent assignment when your computer suddenly stops working. You try restarting it, but nothing happens. You see a staﬀ member nearby who might be able to help or direct you to someone who can. What would you say?
answer: Excuse me, I 'm working on an urgent assignment when my computer suddenly crashed and won 't restart. Could you please help me troubleshoot or direct me to tech support? I 'm worried about losing my work and meeting the deadline. I 'd really appreciate any immediate assistance you can provide.
situation_zh: 您正在校园图书馆处理一项紧急任务，这时您的计算机突然停止工作。您尝试重新启动它，但没有任何反应。您看到附近有一位工作人员可能能够为您提供帮助或指导您找到可以帮助您的人。你会说什么？
answer_zh: 打扰一下，我正在处理一项紧急任务，突然我的电脑死机了并且无法重新启动。您能帮我解决问题或指导我寻求技术支持吗？我担心会失去工作并按时完成任务。我非常感谢您能提供的任何立即帮助。

situation: You are a student living in university accommodation, and the heater in your room has stopped working. It’s the middle of winter and your room is uncomfortably cold, especially at night. You go to the accommodation manager’s oﬃce to report the problem. What do you say to the accommodation manager?
answer: Excuse me, I need to report a broken heater in my room (Room 205). It 's been out since yesterday and the temperature is unbearable, especially at night. Could you please arrange for repairs as soon as possible? I 'd really appreciate your help with this urgent matter during this cold weather.
situation_zh: 您是一名住在大学宿舍的学生，您房间的暖气已停止工作。现在是隆冬，你的房间寒冷得令人不舒服，尤其是在晚上。您去住宿经理办公室报告问题。你想对住宿经理说什么？
answer_zh: 打扰一下，我需要报告我房间（205 室）的加热器坏了。从昨天开始就已经出去了，气温让人难以忍受，尤其是晚上。可以请您尽快安排维修吗？在这寒冷的天气里，我非常感谢您帮助解决这个紧急问题。

situation: You are in the student lounge when a classmate tells you they are struggling to keep up with assignments and often miss deadlines because they can 't manage their time. They seem frustrated and ask for your help. You remember you used to be disorganized too but have learned some strategies. What do you say to your classmate?
answer: I completely understand - I struggled with this too until I started using a planner and breaking tasks into smaller steps. Would you like to meet after class? I 'd be happy to share what worked for me, like prioritizing tasks and setting phone reminders. We could even study together!
situation_zh: 当你在学生休息室时，一位同学告诉你，他们正在努力跟上作业，并且经常错过最后期限，因为他们无法管理自己的时间。他们看起来很沮丧并寻求你的帮助。你记得你曾经也很混乱，但已经学会了一些策略。你对你的同学说什么？
answer_zh: 我完全理解 - 我也曾为此苦苦挣扎，直到我开始使用计划器并将任务分解为更小的步骤。你想下课后见面吗？我很乐意分享对我有用的方法，例如确定任务优先级和设置电话提醒。我们甚至可以一起学习！

situation: You are in your second year of university and studying business. You 're interested in ﬁnding an internship for the summer that’s related to your course. After class, you see your professor packing up her things and decide to ask her for some advice. What do you say?
answer: Excuse me, Professor? I 'm looking for a summer business internship to gain practical experience. Could you suggest companies that align with our course content or share tips for applications? I 'd really value your advice as someone familiar with industry expectations. Thank you for your time!
situation_zh: 您正在大学二年级学习商科。您有兴趣寻找与您的课程相关的暑期实习机会。下课后，你看到你的教授正在收拾她的东西，并决定向她寻求一些建议。你怎么说？
answer_zh: 对不起，教授？我正在寻找暑期商业实习机会以获得实践经验。您能否推荐与我们的课程内容相符的公司或分享申请技巧？作为熟悉行业期望的人，我非常重视您的建议。谢谢您的宝贵时间！

situation: You are working on a group presentation for class, and your teammates just decided on the order of presenters. They want you to go ﬁrst, but you feel unprepared and think it would be better to go later. You’re in a meeting with your group now. What do you say to your teammates?
answer: I 'm honored you 'd like me to present ﬁrst! To ensure our team makes the strongest start, would it be possible for me to go second or third? I 'd like to incorporate some key points from others ' presentations. Of course, if the group prefers me to begin, I 'll do my absolute best!
situation_zh: 您正在为课堂进行小组演示，您的队友刚刚决定了演示者的顺序。他们希望你先走，但你感觉没有准备好，认为晚点走会更好。您现在正在与您的小组开会。你会对你的队友说什么？
answer_zh: 我很荣幸您希望我先介绍！为了确保我们队取得最强的开局，我有可能获得第二或第三吗？我想吸收其他人演讲中的一些要点。当然，如果团队希望我开始，我绝对会尽力而为！

situation: You want to copy some documents, but you notice the printer is broken and the red light is ﬂashing. What would you say to the administrator?
answer: Excuse me, I 'm trying to print some documents, but the printer isn 't working - the red light is ﬂashing. Could you please help ﬁx it or direct me to another available printer? I 'd really appreciate your assistance. Thank you!
situation_zh: 您想要复印一些文档，但发现打印机坏了并且红灯闪烁。你想对管理员说什么？
answer_zh: 打扰一下，我正在尝试打印一些文档，但打印机不工作 - 红灯闪烁。您能帮忙修复它或指导我使用另一台可用的打印机吗？我非常感谢您的帮助。谢谢你！

situation: You live with a ﬂat-mate. You have noticed that your ﬂat-mate often uses your desk and stationery when you are not at home. You are concerned about losing your notes and other important items. What would you say to your ﬂat-mate?
answer: Hey Name, I noticed you’ve been using my desk and stationery while I’m out. I don’t mind sharing sometimes, but I’m a bit worried about my notes and important things getting misplaced. Could we chat about setting some boundaries or sharing supplies in a way that works for both of us?
situation_zh: 你和一个室友住在一起。您注意到，当您不在家时，您的室友经常使用您的桌子和文具。您担心丢失笔记和其他重要物品。你会对你的室友说什么？
answer_zh: 嘿，名字，我注意到我外出时你一直在使用我的桌子和文具。有时我不介意分享，但我有点担心我的笔记和重要的东西放错地方。我们可以讨论一下以一种对我们双方都有效的方式设定一些界限或共享物资吗？

situation: You are in the library and want to use the photocopier, but it is not working because the red light is ﬂashing. You need to ask the library assistant to ﬁx it. What would you say?
answer: Excuse me, I was trying to use the photocopier, but it seems to be malfunctioning-the red light is ﬂashing, and it won’t start. I’m not sure if it needs a paper reﬁll, a toner replacement, or just a quick reset. Could you please take a look or guide me to another available copier? I’d really appreciate your help. Thank you!
situation_zh: 您在图书馆想要使用复印机，但由于红灯闪烁而无法使用。您需要请图书馆助理来修复它。你会说什么？
answer_zh: 打扰一下，我正在尝试使用复印机，但它似乎出现故障——红灯闪烁，而且无法启动。我不确定它是否需要补充纸张、更换碳粉，或者只是快速重置。您能看一下或引导我到另一台可用的复印机吗？我非常感谢你的帮助。谢谢你！

situation: You are studying for an important exam in a quiet section of the library. A group of students nearby is speaking loudly, making it hard for you to concentrate. You notice a librarian at the help desk a few steps away. What would you say to the librarian?
answer: "Excuse me, I’m sorry to bother you—but there’s a group speaking loudly over by the windows. I’m studying for an exam and struggling to focus. Would it be possible to remind them about the quiet zone rules? Thank you for your help! "
situation_zh: 您正在图书馆一个安静的区域准备一场重要的考试。旁边一群学生大声说话，让你很难集中注意力。您注意到几步之外的服务台有一位图书管理员。你想对图书管理员说什么？
answer_zh: “对不起，很抱歉打扰您——窗外有一群人在大声说话。我正在准备考试，注意力很难集中。能否提醒他们有关安静区的规则？谢谢您的帮助！”

situation: You are in the library studying for a very important exam. Your classmate invites you to a party this weekend, but you really need to focus on your studies. You want to politely decline their invitation without hurting their feelings. What would you say?
answer: "Thanks so much for inviting me! I’d love to hang out, but I’ve got a super important exam to study for this weekend. Can I take a rain check? I really need to crush this exam ﬁrst! "
situation_zh: 您正在图书馆准备一场非常重要的考试。你的同学邀请你参加这个周末的聚会，但你真的需要专注于你的学习。您想礼貌地拒绝他们的邀请，而又不伤害他们的感情。你会说什么？
answer_zh: “非常感谢你邀请我！我很想出去玩，但是这个周末我有一场非常重要的考试要复习。我可以参加临时考试吗？我真的需要先把这次考试搞定！”

situation: You are checking your grade for a recent assignment and you feel your work deserved a higher mark. After class, you approach your lecturer to talk about it. You would like them to review your paper again and explain how the grade was decided. What would you say?
answer: "Excuse me, Dr. Lee. I reviewed the feedback on Assignment 2 and was hoping you could help me understand how the grade was determined. I’d appreciate it if you could revisit my work—I want to make sure I meet expectations for future assignments. "
situation_zh: 您正在检查最近作业的成绩，并且您认为您的工作应该获得更高的分数。下课后，你去找讲师讨论这个问题。您希望他们再次审阅您的论文并解释成绩是如何决定的。你会说什么？
answer_zh: “对不起，李博士。我查看了作业 2 的反馈，希望您能帮助我了解如何确定成绩。如果您能重新审视我的工作，我将不胜感激 - 我想确保我满足对未来作业的期望。”

situation: You are working on an assignment for your history class, but you are confused about what the professor expects in one of the questions. You read the instructions several times but are still unsure how to approach it. After class, you decide to ask your professor to clarify. What would you say?
answer: "Excuse me, Professor. I’ve reviewed the instructions for Question 3, but I’m still unsure how to approach it. Could you please clarify what you’re looking for in the answer? Thank you! "
situation_zh: 您正在为历史课做作业，但您对教授对其中一个问题的期望感到困惑。您多次阅读说明，但仍然不确定如何处理它。课后，你决定请教授澄清一下。你会说什么？
answer_zh: “对不起，教授。我已经查看了问题 3 的说明，但我仍然不确定如何处理它。您能澄清一下您在答案中寻找什么吗？谢谢！”

situation: You are chatting with a classmate after your language class. You’ve just found out about a fun language exchange event happening this weekend on campus. It’s a good opportunity to practice speaking with students from diﬀerent countries. You’d like to invite your classmate to come with you. What would you say?
answer: "Hey, I just found out about this fun language exchange event on campus this weekend. It’s a great chance to practice speaking with students from diﬀerent countries. Want to go together? "
situation_zh: 语言课结束后，您正在与一位同学聊天。您刚刚了解到本周末校园内将举办一场有趣的语言交流活动。这是一个与来自不同国家的学生练习口语的好机会。你想邀请你的同学和你一起去。你会说什么？
answer_zh: “嘿，我刚刚知道这个周末校园里有一个有趣的语言交流活动。这是一个和来自不同国家的学生练习口语的好机会。想一起去吗？”

situation: You are looking for a job at your university. One day, you see a notice about a job in the campus cafeteria. You meet the cafeteria manager. Ask them what kind of job it is and what you would need to do in this position.
answer: Hi there, I 'm a student here and saw the job notice posted in the cafeteria. Could you tell me what kind of position this is and what the main responsibilities would be? I’d love to learn more about what the role involves day-to-day.
situation_zh: 您正在您的大学寻找工作。有一天，你在校园食堂看到一则招聘启事。你遇到了食堂经理。询问他们这是什么类型的工作以及您在这个职位上需要做什么。
answer_zh: 你好，我是这里的一名学生，看到了食堂张贴的招聘启事。您能告诉我这是一个什么样的职位以及主要职责是什么吗？我很想更多地了解这个角色的日常工作。

situation: You are studying in the campus library. A group of students sitting near you are talking loudly and disturbing your concentration. What would you say to them to handle the situation politely? Please give your response as if you were speaking to them.
answer: Excuse me, I hope you don’t mind me mentioning this—I’m trying to study nearby and having a bit of trouble concentrating with the conversation volume. Would you be able to lower your voices or maybe move to a group study area? I’d really appreciate it!
situation_zh: 你正在校园图书馆学习。一群坐在你附近的学生大声说话，干扰了你的注意力。您会对他们说什么以礼貌地处理这种情况？请像对他们说话一样做出回应。
answer_zh: 抱歉，我希望你不介意我提一下这一点——我正在附近学习，但谈话音量有点难以集中注意力。你能降低声音或者转移到小组学习区吗？我真的很感激！

situation: You are in class when you remember that you will be traveling overseas next week to attend a family event. You realize that you will miss one of your lectures and possibly an assignment deadline. After class, you approach your professor to inform them about your trip. What do you say to your professor?
situation_zh: 当您在课堂上时，您想起下周您将出国参加家庭活动。您意识到您将错过一场讲座，甚至可能错过作业截止日期。下课后，你去找教授，告诉他们你的旅行。你对你的教授说什么？

situation: You are a student and you keep getting locked out of your university account. You 've reset your password multiple times, but the problem persists. You call IT support to explain the situation and ask for a more permanent solution. What would you say?
answer: Hi, I 'm a student experiencing repeated account lockouts despite password resets. Could you investigate if there 's a system issue or provide a permanent solution? My student ID is [XYZ].
situation_zh: 您是一名学生，但您的大学帐户一直被锁定。您已多次重置密码，但问题仍然存在。您致电 IT 支持人员解释情况并请求更永久的解决方案。你会说什么？
answer_zh: 您好，我是一名学生，尽管重置了密码，但帐户仍多次被锁定。您能否调查是否存在系统问题或提供永久解决方案？我的学生 ID 是 [XYZ]。

situation: You are a university student who scheduled an appointment to meet with your professor during oﬃce hours to ask for help with an assignment. However, you missed the meeting because you were stuck in traﬃc and couldn 't make it on time. You now see your professor in the hallway later that day. What would you say?
answer: "Professor, I sincerely apologize for missing our meeting - I got stuck in unexpected traﬃc. Could we possibly reschedule? I truly value your guidance on this assignment. "
situation_zh: 您是一名大学生，您预约了在办公时间与您的教授会面，寻求作业帮助。然而，您因为交通堵塞而未能准时参加会议，因此错过了会议。那天晚些时候你会在走廊里看到你的教授。你会说什么？
answer_zh: “教授，对于错过我们的会议，我深表歉意 - 我遇到了意外的交通堵塞。我们可以重新安排时间吗？我真的很重视您对这项作业的指导。”

situation: You are in the library working on a diﬃcult assignment. A classmate, who you know hasn 't started the work, approaches you and asks if they can copy your nearly completed assignment because they are out of time. You don 't want to give them your work. What would you say?
answer: Sorry, but I don 't share assignments - that 's against academic rules. I can explain some concepts if you want to quickly start yours? "
situation_zh: 您正在图书馆完成一项艰巨的任务。一位你知道还没有开始作业的同学走近你，询问是否可以抄写你即将完成的作业，因为他们没有时间了。你不想把你的工作交给他们。你会说什么？
answer_zh: 抱歉，我不分享作业——这违反了学术规则。如果您想快速开始自己的概念，我可以解释一些概念吗？ ”

situation: You are scheduled to work in the biology lab next Tuesday at 10 am. However, you have a very important doctor 's appointment that day that you cannot reschedule. You need to ask your lab partner if they would be willing to switch lab times with you next week. What would you say?
answer: Hi [Name], I have a conﬂict with our Tuesday 10 am lab—I’ve got an unmissable doctor’s appointment. Would you be willing to switch lab times with me next week? I’d be happy to return the favor anytime!
situation_zh: 你计划下周二上午 10 点在生物实验室工作。但是，您当天有一个非常重要的医生预约，无法重新安排。您需要询问您的实验室合作伙伴是否愿意在下周与您调换实验室时间。你会说什么？
answer_zh: 你好，[姓名]，我与周二上午 10 点的实验室发生了冲突——我有一个不容错过的医生预约。下周你愿意和我调换实验室时间吗？我很乐意随时回报您的恩惠！

situation: You are on your way to a group meeting in the library to prepare for an upcoming exam. However, you just received an urgent phone call from a family member and need to deal with it before joining the group. You know the meeting has already started. You call one of your classmates to let them know. What would you say?
answer: Hi [Name], I’m so sorry—I just got an urgent family call and need to handle it before heading to the library. I’ll be there as soon as I can, probably [estimate time, e.g., 20 minutes]. Could you ﬁll me in on what I miss? Really appreciate it!
situation_zh: 您正在去图书馆参加小组会议的路上，为即将到来的考试做准备。然而，您刚刚接到家人打来的紧急电话，需要先处理一下再加入群组。你知道会议已经开始了。你打电话给你的一位同学让他们知道。你会说什么？
answer_zh: 嗨，[姓名]，非常抱歉，我刚刚接到一个紧急的家庭电话，需要在前往图书馆之前处理一下。我会尽快赶到，大概[估计时间，例如 20 分钟]。你能告诉我我错过了什么吗？真的很感激！

situation: You are living in a student dorm and recently noticed that the refrigerator in your shared kitchen is not cooling properly. Some of your food has spoiled, and it 's becoming a real inconvenience. You decide to speak to the accommodation manager about the issue. What do you say to the accommodation manager?
answer: I’m sorry to bother you, but the shared fridge in our dorm has stopped cooling properly. Several students, including myself, have lost food because of this. Would it be possible to arrange a repair? We’d really appreciate your help.
situation_zh: 您住在学生宿舍，最近发现共用厨房的冰箱无法正常制冷。您的一些食物已经变质，这确实带来了不便。您决定与住宿经理讨论这个问题。你想对住宿经理说什么？
answer_zh: 很抱歉打扰您，我们宿舍的共用冰箱已经停止正常制冷了。包括我在内的一些学生因此失去了食物。可以安排维修吗？我们非常感谢您的帮助。

situation: You are in the student center and realize you lost your headphones earlier today. You think you might have dropped them in the library or the cafeteria. You decide to go to the campus security oﬃce to see if someone turned them in. What do you say to the campus security oﬃcer?
answer: Hi, I think I lost my headphones earlier today—they might be in the library or cafeteria. Has anyone turned them in? They’re describe color/brand if needed. I’d really appreciate any help ﬁnding them.
situation_zh: 您在学生中心并意识到今天早些时候您丢失了耳机。您认为您可能将它们掉在图书馆或自助餐厅里。你决定去校园保安办公室看看是否有人举报它们。你对校园保安人员说什么？
answer_zh: 嗨，我想我今天早些时候丢了耳机——它们可能在图书馆或自助餐厅。有人把它们交出来了吗？如果需要，他们会描述颜色/品牌。我真的很感激任何帮助找到他们的人。

situation: You share an apartment with a roommate and have both agreed to split the cleaning duties each week. Lately, you’ve noticed that your roommate hasn’t been doing their part, and it 's starting to bother you. You want to bring it up without starting an argument. You see your roommate in the kitchen. What would you say?
answer: "Hey [Roommate’s Name], could we check in about our cleaning schedule? I’ve noticed some tasks have been slipping lately, and I want to make sure we’re both on the same page. Maybe we could adjust the system if it’s not working for you?
situation_zh: 您与室友合住一间公寓，并同意每周分担清洁工作。最近，你发现你的室友没有尽到自己的职责，这开始让你烦恼。你想在不引发争论的情况下提出它。你在厨房里看到你的室友。你会说什么？
answer_zh: “嘿[室友的名字]，我们可以检查一下我们的清洁时间表吗？我注意到最近有些任务进展缓慢，我想确保我们都在同一页面上。如果系统不适合您，也许我们可以调整系统？

situation: You are walking out of your lecture and realize you didn’t understand some of the main points your professor was making. You see a classmate who you think took good notes and paid attention during class. You want to ask them for help understanding what was covered. What would you say?
answer: "Hey [Name], I think you paid really good attention in class today. I missed a few of the main points—would you mind explaining them to me? I’d really appreciate it! "
situation_zh: 当你走出讲座时，你意识到你不明白教授提出的一些要点。您看到一位同学，您认为他在课堂上记得很好并且注意力集中。您想请求他们帮助您了解所涵盖的内容。你会说什么？
answer_zh: “嘿[姓名]，我认为你今天在课堂上非常专心。我错过了一些要点——你介意向我解释一下吗？我真的很感激！”

situation: You are working on a group presentation for one of your classes. Each person was assigned a section to complete by the weekend. However, you were unable to ﬁnish your part because of a family emergency. You meet with your group the next day. What would you say to them?
answer: Hi everyone, I wanted to let you know that I wasn’t able to ﬁnish my part of the presentation because of an unexpected family emergency. I’m really sorry for the delay—I’ll get it done as soon as possible. If there’s anything I can do to make up for it or if you need me to adjust my section to ﬁt the timeline, just let me know.
situation_zh: You are working on a group presentation for one of your classes. Each person was assigned a section to complete by the weekend. However, you were unable to ﬁnish your part because of a family emergency.第二天您将与您的小组见面。你会对他们说什么？
answer_zh: 大家好，我想让你们知道，由于家庭突发紧急情况，我无法完成我的演示部分。对于耽搁了我真的很抱歉——我会尽快完成。如果我能做些什么来弥补，或者如果您需要我调整我的部分以适应时间线，请告诉我。

situation: You are in your second year of university and have been working on a big assignment for your psychology class. Unfortunately, you’ve had the ﬂu for the past week and couldn’t concentrate or get much work done. You have a doctor’s note and feel a little better now. You go to your lecturer’s oﬃce to talk. What would you say?
answer: Hi [Lecturer’s Name], I’ve been working on the psychology assignment, but I came down with the ﬂu last week and couldn’t focus or make much progress. I have a doctor’s note here if needed. I’m feeling better now—would it be possible to get a short extension to ﬁnish the assignment properly?
situation_zh: 你现在是大学二年级的学生，一直在为心理学课做一项艰巨的作业。不幸的是，您过去一周患了流感，无法集中注意力或完成很多工作。您有医生证明并且现在感觉好一点了。你去你的讲师办公室谈话。你会说什么？
answer_zh: 你好[讲师姓名]，我一直在做心理学作业，但上周我得了流感，无法集中注意力或取得太大进展。如果需要的话，我这里有医生的证明。我现在感觉好多了——是否有可能获得短暂的延期以妥善完成作业？

situation: You bought a car last week. You want to start driving it to school but you need to buy a parking pass. You know your friend drives their car and parks on campus. You decide to ask your friend where you can get a parking pass, how much it is, and where you should park. What do you say?
answer: Hey [Friend 's Name], I just bought a car and plan to drive to school. I know you park on campus—could you tell me where to get a parking pass, how much it costs, and the best spot to park? Thanks!
situation_zh: 你上周买了一辆车。您想开始驾驶它去学校，但您需要购买停车证。您知道您的朋友开车并将车停在校园内。您决定询问您的朋友在哪里可以获得停车证、费用是多少以及应该在哪里停车。你怎么说？
answer_zh: 嘿[朋友的名字]，我刚买了一辆车，打算开车去学校。我知道你把车停在校园里，你能告诉我在哪里可以获得停车证、费用是多少以及最佳停车地点吗？谢谢！

situation: You chose to study on a politics course but you have changed your mind. You think a history course might be better but you 're not sure what the course includes. What do you say to your teacher to get some advice?
answer: Excuse me, I initially enrolled in the politics course but I 'm reconsidering. I think history might suit me better, but I 'm unsure about the course content. Could you please explain what topics the history course covers, how it 's assessed, and what career paths it prepares students for? I 'd like to compare before making my ﬁnal decision
situation_zh: 您选择学习政治课程，但您改变了主意。您认为历史课程可能更好，但您不确定该课程包括哪些内容。你会向你的老师说什么以获得建议？
answer_zh: 对不起，我最初报名参加了政治课程，但我正在重新考虑。我认为历史可能更适合我，但我不确定课程内容。您能否解释一下历史课程涵盖哪些主题、如何评估以及它为学生准备哪些职业道路？我想在做出最终决定之前进行比较

situation: You have decided that you don 't want to take the course in Mechanical Engineering. Your friend has dropped a course recently. You want your friend to tell you the correct procedure to follow and when he deadline is for getting a tuition refund. What do you say?
answer: Hey! I’ve decided to drop Mechanical Engineering. Since you just withdrew from a course, could you tell me the exact steps—portal clicks, advisor form, anything else - and the ﬁnal deadline for a full tuition refund? I want to be sure I don’t miss any steps before the cut-oﬀ .
situation_zh: 您已决定不想学习机械工程课程。你的朋友最近放弃了一门课程。您希望您的朋友告诉您应遵循的正确程序以及获得学费退款的截止日期。你怎么说？
answer_zh: 嘿！我决定放弃机械工程。由于您刚刚退出课程，您能否告诉我确切的步骤（门户点击、顾问表格或其他任何内容）以及全额学费退款的最终期限？我想确保在截止时间之前我不会错过任何步骤。

situation: One of your friends from school is going away to start university next week. She 's excited but sad to say goodbye. Some of you are discussing ideas for a present to give her new apartment. What would you suggest to them?
answer: How about a little "survival box "? Pack a cute mug, her favorite tea, instant noodles, a framed photo of the group, and a tiny plant. It’s cheap, ﬁts in any suitcase, and every sip or glance will remind her she’s loved.
situation_zh: 你的一位学校朋友下周就要离开学校去上大学。她很兴奋，但又很难过地说再见。你们中的一些人正在讨论为她的新公寓准备一份礼物的想法。你会给他们什么建议？
answer_zh: 一个小“生存箱”怎么样？带上一个可爱的杯子、她最喜欢的茶、方便面、一张镶框的集体照片和一棵小植物。它价格便宜，适合任何手提箱，每喝一口或看一眼都会提醒她她被爱着。

situation: You are in a class at college. The two students sitting next to you keep talking to each other. You can 't hear anything your teacher is saying. What would you say to them?
answer: Excuse me, could you two keep it down a bit? I’m ﬁnding it hard to hear what the teacher is saying. Thanks a lot.
situation_zh: 你在大学的一个班级里。坐在你旁边的两个学生一直在互相交谈。你听不到老师在说什么。你会对他们说什么？
answer_zh: 打扰一下，你们两个能小声一点吗？我发现很难听清老师在说什么。多谢。

situation: You have a part time job at the university library. Your manager has asked you to work overtime on saturday, but you 'll miss the last bus home. Your friend has a car and might be able to help. What would you say to them?
answer: Hey [Friend 's Name], I hope you’re free to chat for a second. So, my library manager just asked if I can work overtime this Saturday—it’s a bit last minute, but they really need the help. The only issue is that by the time I ﬁnish, I’ll miss the last bus home. I know you have a car, and I was wondering if you’d be able to give me a lift back then? I totally get if you’re busy, but I’d really appreciate it. Let me know what works for you!
situation_zh: 你在大学图书馆有一份兼职工作。你的经理要求你周六加班，但你会错过回家的末班车。您的朋友有车，也许可以提供帮助。你会对他们说什么？
answer_zh: 嘿[朋友的名字]，希望您能抽空聊聊。所以，我的图书馆经理只是问我这个周六是否可以加班——这有点最后一刻了，但他们确实需要帮助。唯一的问题是，当我完成时，我将错过回家的末班车。我知道你有车，我想知道你当时能不能载我一程？如果你很忙，我完全理解，但我真的很感激。让我知道什么对你有用！

title_zh: 解决对汽车借用的担忧
situation: You 've lent your car to a friend for a weekend trip. Upon its return, you notice the interior is much dirtier than before. You need to discuss this with your friend to address the care of your property and the importance of respecting the agreements made. What would you say to your friend?
answer: Hey, I noticed the car 's interior is much dirtier than before. We agreed to keep it clean, and 'm a bit disappointed. l understand accidents happen, but l think it 's fair to ﬁnd a solution ,like sharing the cleaning cost or maybe you could take it for professional cleaning. This way, we respect our agreement and maintain our friendship
situation_zh: 您已将汽车借给朋友进行周末旅行。返回后，您发现内部比以前脏得多。您需要与您的朋友讨论这个问题，以解决您财产的保管问题以及尊重所达成协议的重要性。你会对你的朋友说什么？
answer_zh: 嘿，我发现车子的内部比以前脏多了。我们同意保持干净，但有点失望。我理解事故的发生，但我认为找到解决方案是公平的，例如分担清洁费用或者也许您可以将其进行专业清洁。这样，我们就尊重我们的约定，维持我们的友谊

situation: You sign up for a photography lesson advertised as covering a wide range of techniques and oﬀering hands-on practice. However, when you attend the lesson, you ﬁnd that only basic topics are covered, and there 's minimal opportunity for practical application. How do you address this with the lesson organizer?
answer: Hi, l have some concerns about the photography lesson. The content was nowhere near as advanced as advertised .l expected hands-on practice and in-depth exploration of techniques, but it was disappointingly basic, l feel let down and frustrated, considering the investment made in this opportunity could we discuss potential solutions, like a refund or additional sessions focusing on the promised topics? want to ensure future participants receive the quality they expect.
situation_zh: 您报名参加了一个摄影课程，广告上宣传该课程涵盖广泛的技术并提供实践练习。然而，当你参加课程时，你会发现只涵盖了基本主题，实际应用的机会很少。您如何与课程组织者解决这个问题？
answer_zh: 你好，我对摄影课有一些担忧。内容远没有宣传的那么先进。我期望的是动手实践和对技术的深入探索，但它的基础令人失望，我感到失望和沮丧，考虑到在这个机会中所做的投资，我们可以讨论潜在的解决方案，例如退款或专注于承诺主题的额外会议吗？希望确保未来的参与者获得他们期望的质量。

situation: You will prepare barbecue and salad to treat them, but you do not know their dietary restrictions. You made a phone call to ask them about this, but they did not answer the call. Please leave a message to them.
answer: Hi! I just tried giving you a call, but it seems you weren’t available, so I’m leaving this message.I’m preparing a barbecue and some salad for when you come over, but I’m not sure about your dietary restrictions or preferences. If you have any food allergies, if you 're vegetarian, or if there’s anything you don’t eat, please let me know when you get a chance. I’d love to make sure everyone feels comfortable and enjoys the meal. Looking forward to seeing you soon!
situation_zh: 你会准备烧烤和沙拉来款待他们，但你不知道他们的饮食限制。你打电话询问他们此事，但他们没有接听电话。请给他们留言。
answer_zh: 你好！我刚刚尝试给您打电话，但您似乎没空，所以我留下了这条消息。我正在为您过来时准备烧烤和一些沙拉，但我不确定您的饮食限制或偏好。如果您有任何食物过敏，如果您是素食主义者，或者有什么您不吃的东西，请一有机会就告诉我。我很想确保每个人都感到舒适并享受这顿饭。期待很快见到您！

title_en: Asking About Room and Balcony Items
situation: You are staying at your friend Beth 's apartment. Her room is messy and there are some things on the balcony. You need to call her.What do you say to her?
answer: Hey Beth, thanks so much again for letting me stay at your apartment—really appreciate it! I just wanted to check with you about something. The room is a little messy, and there are quite a few things out on the balcony. I was wondering if it’s okay for me to move a few things around, just to make the space a bit more comfortable while I’m here. No rush—just let me know what you’d prefer. Hope everything’s going well on your end!
situation_zh: 您住在您朋友贝丝的公寓里。她的房间很乱，阳台上还有一些东西。你需要给她打电话。你对她说什么？
answer_zh: 嘿贝丝，再次非常感谢您让我入住您的公寓 - 真的很感激！我只是想和你确认一件事。房间有点乱，阳台上东西也不少。我想知道我是否可以移动一些东西，只是为了让我在这里时的空间更舒适一些。不用着急，只需告诉我您想要什么即可。希望您一切顺利！

situation: You and your friends have diﬀerent restaurant preferences for a night out. How should you approach the conversation to express your preference for a diﬀerent restaurant, and what points should you cover to reach a compromise that considers everyone 's opinions?
answer: Hey guys, I know we all have diﬀerent tastes when it comes to restaurants, and that’s totally okay! I was actually hoping we could try a diﬀerent place this time—maybe something with more vegetarian options, since I’ve been trying to eat lighter lately. I know you really like the burger place, and I’m happy to go there another time. But maybe tonight we could go somewhere new that has a bit of everything for everyone? Let’s look at a few menus together and pick one that works for all of us. Sound good?
situation_zh: 您和您的朋友晚上外出时对餐厅的偏好不同。您应该如何通过谈话来表达您对不同餐厅的偏好？您应该涵盖哪些要点才能达成考虑每个人意见的妥协方案？
answer_zh: 嘿伙计们，我知道我们在餐馆方面都有不同的口味，这完全没关系！我实际上希望这次我们能尝试一个不同的地方——也许有更多素食选择，因为我最近一直在尝试吃得清淡一些。我知道你真的很喜欢汉堡店，我很高兴下次再去那里。但也许今晚我们可以去一个新的地方，那里有适合每个人的一切？让我们一起看一些菜单，然后选择一个适合我们所有人的菜单。听起来不错吗？

situation: You and your friends have diﬀerent restaurant preferences for a night out. How should you approach the conversation to express your preference for a diﬀerent restaurant, and what points should you cover to reach a compromise that considers everyone 's opinions?
answer: Hey guys, I know we all have diﬀerent tastes when it comes to food, and I totally respect that. I was thinking, instead of going to the usual place, maybe we could try this other restaurant I really like—it has a wider variety of dishes, including vegetarian and spicy options, so it might suit more of us. Of course, I’m open to suggestions, and maybe we can take turns choosing places or vote on it to keep things fair. I just want everyone to enjoy the night out together!
situation_zh: 您和您的朋友晚上外出时对餐厅的偏好不同。您应该如何通过谈话来表达您对不同餐厅的偏好？您应该涵盖哪些要点才能达成考虑每个人意见的妥协方案？
answer_zh: 嘿伙计们，我知道我们在食物方面都有不同的口味，我完全尊重这一点。我在想，与其去平常的地方，也许我们可以尝试一下我真正喜欢的另一家餐厅——它的菜品种类更丰富，有素食和辛辣的选择，所以它可能适合我们更多的人。当然，我愿意接受建议，也许我们可以轮流选择地点或投票以保持公平。我只是想让大家一起享受夜晚！

situation: As a university student sharing a dorm with a consistently messy and inconsiderate roommate, you’ve attempted discussions without success. Frustrated and unsure of what to do, you plan to consult your resident advisor. What do you say to your RA?
answer: Hi, I hope you have a moment. I wanted to talk to you about an ongoing issue with my roommate. I 've tried bringing it up with them a few times, but nothing has changed. They're consistently messy, leave food out, and play loud music late at night. It 's been really aﬀecting my ability to focus and feel comfortable in our room. I 'm not sure what to do next, so I thought it might be best to talk to you and see if there 's any way you could help mediate or suggest a solution. I 'd really appreciate any advice or support.
situation_zh: 作为一名大学生，你与一位一贯凌乱且不体贴的室友同住一间宿舍，你曾尝试过讨论，但没有成功。由于沮丧且不确定该怎么办，您计划咨询您的常驻顾问。您对您的 RA 有什么想说的？
answer_zh: 你好，我希望你能抽出一点时间。我想和你谈谈我和室友之间一直存在的问题。我曾多次尝试向他们提出这个问题，但没有任何改变。他们总是很乱，把食物放在外面，并在深夜大声播放音乐。这确实影响了我在房间里集中注意力和感觉舒适的能力。我不确定下一步该怎么做，所以我认为最好与您谈谈，看看您是否可以帮助调解或提出解决方案。我真的很感激任何建议或支持。

situation: You 're at the gym, ﬁnishing up your workout, when your workout buddy asks if you 're available to spot him for his heavy lifts tomorrow morning. However, you realize you have a doctor 's appointment scheduled at the same time. What would you say to him?
answer: I would love to help you out,but unfortunately, l have a doctor 's appointment tomorow morning, so l won 't be avalable to spot you at that time. How about we plan for later in the aftemoon or another day this week? " 'm deﬁnitely down to spot you, but l just need to work around this appointment.Let me know what works best for you, and let 's do it together
situation_zh: 当你在健身房结束锻炼时，你的锻炼伙伴问你是否可以在明天早上陪他进行大重量举重训练。然而，您发现您同时预约了医生。你会对他说什么？
answer_zh: I would love to help you out,but unfortunately, l have a doctor 's appointment tomorow morning, so l won 't be avalable to spot you at that time.我们计划在下午晚些时候或本周的另一天进行怎么样？ " 'm deﬁnitely down to spot you, but l just need to work around this appointment.Let me know what works best for you, and let 's do it together

situation: Your teacher scheduled a tutorial session for this afternoon, but you have an important competition to attend at the same time. How would you explain this to your teacher and request an alternative arrangement?
answer: Excuse me, professor. I wanted to let you know that I have a sports competition scheduled for this afternoon, which conﬂicts with the tutorial. I really value the session, so could I possibly attend a make-up class or review the material one-on-one later? I’d be happy to complete any extra work to catch up. Thank you for your ﬂexibility!
situation_zh: 你的老师安排了今天下午的辅导课，但你同时还有一场重要的比赛要参加。您将如何向您的老师解释这一点并请求替代安排？
answer_zh: 对不起，教授。我想让你知道我今天下午安排了一场体育比赛，这与教程相冲突。我真的很重视这次课程，所以我可以参加补课或稍后一对一复习材料吗？我很乐意完成任何额外的工作来赶上。感谢您的灵活性！

situation: You have a roommate, but he usually does not clean. You cannot stand dirty common areas. You’re going to talk to him. What are you going to say to your roommate?
answer: Hey, do you have a minute to talk? I just wanted to bring something up. I 've noticed that the common areas like the kitchen and bathroom often stay messy, and honestly, it 's been bothering me a bit. I totally understand that we both get busy, but I think it’s important for us to keep those shared spaces clean so we both feel comfortable at home. Maybe we can come up with a simple cleaning schedule or take turns each week—what do you think? I’m not trying to blame anyone, I just really want us to have a clean and nice living environment.
situation_zh: 你有一个室友，但他通常不打扫卫生。您无法忍受肮脏的公共区域。你要和他说话。你想对你的室友说什么？
answer_zh: 嘿，你有时间谈谈吗？我只是想提出一些事情。我注意到厨房和浴室等公共区域经常很乱，说实话，这让我有点困扰。我完全理解我们都很忙，但我认为保持这些共享空间的清洁对我们来说很重要，这样我们都感觉像在家里一样舒服。也许我们可以制定一个简单的清洁计划，或者每周轮流清洁——你觉得怎么样？我并不是要责怪任何人，我只是真的希望我们有一个干净、美好的生活环境。

situation: Your ﬂat-mate 's visitors don 't follow the rules, and your food in the fridge keeps disappearing. You need to talk to your ﬂat-mate about it. What will you say?
answer: Hey, could we chat for a sec? Lately, I noticed your visitors sometimes don’t follow our ﬂat rules, and my food in the fridge has gone missing a few times too. It’s a bit frustrating—do you think we could remind them together? That’d help keep things smooth for both of us.
situation_zh: 你室友的访客不遵守规则，你冰箱里的食物不断消失。你需要和你的室友谈谈这件事。你会说什么？
answer_zh: 嘿，我们可以聊一会儿吗？最近，我注意到你们的访客有时不遵守我们的公寓规则，我冰箱里的食物也失踪了几次。有点沮丧——你认为我们可以一起提醒他们吗？这有助于让我们俩的事情顺利进行。

situation: Your neighbor has been playing loud music late at night, making it diﬃcult for you to sleep. How would you address this situation diplomatically while maintaining a good relationship?
answer: Hi there, hope you 're doing well! I wanted to mention something sensitive - I 've been having trouble sleeping recently because the music carries so clearly at night. I completely understand you enjoy your music, but would you consider using headphones after 10pm? Or maybe lowering the bass a little? I 'd really appreciate it - I 've got early work shifts, and this would help me tremendously. Thanks so much for being understanding!
situation_zh: 你的邻居在深夜大声播放音乐，让你难以入睡。您将如何在保持良好关系的同时以外交方式解决这种情况？
answer_zh: 你好，希望你一切顺利！我想提一些敏感的事情 - 我最近一直难以入睡，因为音乐在晚上传播得如此清晰。我完全理解您喜欢音乐，但是您会考虑在晚上 10 点之后使用耳机吗？或者稍微降低低音？我真的很感激——我有很早的轮班，这对我有很大帮助。非常感谢您的理解！

title_en: Thanking a Tutor for Detailed Feedback
situation: You are checking your latest essay grade online and notice that your tutor left detailed feedback on every paragraph, including useful suggestions. You’re surprised and impressed by how much time they must have spent reviewing your work. The next day, you see your tutor in the hallway after class. What would you say to them?
answer: Hi excuse me! I just wanted to say thank you for the detailed feedback you gave on my essay—I really appreciate how thorough you were. I could see you took the time to comment on every paragraph, and your suggestions were super helpful. It honestly means a lot, and it’s given me a clearer idea of how to improve. Thanks again!
situation_zh: 您正在网上查看最新的论文成绩，并注意到您的导师对每个段落都留下了详细的反馈，包括有用的建议。他们花了大量的时间来审查你的工作，这让你感到惊讶和印象深刻。第二天，下课后，你在走廊里见到你的导师。你会对他们说什么？
answer_zh: 嗨，对不起！我只是想说谢谢你对我的论文提供的详细反馈——我真的很感激你的彻底。我可以看到您花时间对每个段落进行评论，您的建议非常有帮助。老实说，这意义重大，它让我对如何改进有了更清晰的想法。再次感谢！

situation: You need help with your ﬁnal project and want to ask your teacher for assistance. How do you approach your teacher to explain the situation and what speciﬁc points do you include to ensure you get the support you need?
answer: Hello, Professor, I hope you’re doing well. I’m currently working on the ﬁnal project, but I’m facing some challenges that I’m struggling to resolve on my own. Speciﬁcally, I’m having diﬃculty with [mention a speciﬁc part, e.g., data analysis, structuring the report, or understanding a key concept]. I was wondering if it would be possible to arrange a time to discuss this with you, so I can get some guidance and make sure I’m on the right track. Any advice or resources you could provide would be really helpful. Thank you very much for your time and support!
situation_zh: 您需要最终项目的帮助，并想向您的老师寻求帮助。你如何向你的老师解释这种情况？你包括哪些具体要点来确保你获得所需的支持？
answer_zh: 你好，教授，希望你一切顺利。我目前正在研究最终的项目，但我面临着一些挑战，我正在努力独自解决。具体来说，我在[提及特定部分，例如数据分析、构建报告或理解关键概念]方面遇到困难。我想知道是否可以安排时间与您讨论这个问题，这样我可以获得一些指导并确保我走在正确的轨道上。您可以提供的任何建议或资源都会非常有帮助。非常感谢您的时间和支持！

situation: You’re at a salon and you want to get a haircut, but you realize that you left your wallet in your taxi. You don’t have the taxi number and you don’t have any other payment methods with you. What will you tell the stylist in order to get this situation sorted?
answer: Hi, I just realized that I left my wallet in the taxi I took here, and unfortunately, I don’t have the taxi number with me.I also don’t have any other payment methods on me right now. I’m really sorry about this—it 's totally unexpected. Is there any way I can pay you later today or maybe transfer the money online? I can give you my contact details, and I’ll make sure to settle the payment as soon as possible. Thanks so much for understanding—I really appreciate your help!
situation_zh: 您在一家沙龙想要理发，但您发现您的钱包落在出租车上。您没有出租车号码，也没有任何其他付款方式。为了解决这个问题，你会告诉造型师什么？
answer_zh: 嗨，我刚刚意识到我把钱包落在了乘坐的出租车上，不幸的是，我没有携带出租车号码。我现在也没有任何其他付款方式。我对此感到非常抱歉——这完全出乎我的意料。今天晚些时候我可以通过什么方式向您付款或者在线转账吗？我可以给你我的联系方式，我会确保尽快结清款项。非常感谢您的理解——非常感谢您的帮助！

situation: You booked a hotel, but the facility is terrible. You want to speak to the manger. What would you say?
answer: Hello, excuse me. I recently booked a room here at this hotel, but I have to say I’m quite disappointed with the facilities so far. For example, some of the equipment in the room isn’t working properly, and the overall condition is not what I expected based on the online description. I wanted to bring this to your attention because I hope there is something that can be done to improve my stay. Could you please let me know if it’s possible to ﬁx these issues soon, or maybe I could be moved to another room with better facilities? I’d really appreciate your help because I want to enjoy my stay here. Thank you very much for understanding.
situation_zh: 你订了酒店，但设施很糟糕。你想和经理说话。你会说什么？
answer_zh: 你好，对不起。我最近在这家酒店预订了房间，但我不得不说到目前为止我对这里的设施感到非常失望。例如，房间内的一些设备无法正常工作，整体状况也不是我根据网上描述所期望的。我想提请您注意这一点，因为我希望可以采取一些措施来改善我的住宿体验。您能否告诉我是否可以尽快解决这些问题，或者我可以搬到另一个设施更好的房间？我非常感谢您的帮助，因为我想在这里过得愉快。非常感谢您的理解。

situation: You overheard your colleagues discussing about renting bikes, which sounds really fun and you are interested in it. Speak to your colleagues and inquire about the details, such as the cost of renting and how and where you can rent a bike.
answer: Hey everyone, sorry to interrupt your conversation, but I just overheard you talking about renting bikes, and it sounds really fun! I’ve been thinking about trying it myself for a while now. Could you please tell me more about it? For example, how much does it usually cost to rent a bike? Also, where can I rent one? Is there a speciﬁc shop nearby, or do you use an app to book the bikes? And do you need to bring any ID or deposit when renting? I’d love to join you next time if that’s possible because it sounds like a great way to get some fresh air and explore the area. Thanks so much for the information—I really appreciate it!
situation_zh: 你无意中听到同事们在讨论租自行车的事，这听起来很有趣，你也对此很感兴趣。与您的同事交谈并询问详细信息，例如租赁费用以及如何以及在哪里可以租用自行车。
answer_zh: 大家好，很抱歉打断你们的谈话，但我刚刚无意中听到你们谈论租赁自行车，听起来真的很有趣！一段时间以来我一直在考虑自己尝试一下。您能告诉我更多相关信息吗？例如，租一辆自行车通常要花多少钱？另外，哪里可以租到呢？附近有特定的商店吗？或者您使用应用程序预订自行车吗？还有租房的时候需要带身份证或者押金吗？如果可能的话，我很乐意下次加入你们，因为这听起来是呼吸新鲜空气和探索该地区的好方法。非常感谢您提供的信息——我真的很感激！

situation: You have some visitors recently and you are busy at work,so you want to apply for extension of project which will due on Friday. What would you say to your Manager?
answer: Hi, I hope you’re doing well. I wanted to talk to you about the project that’s due this Friday. I’ve had some unexpected visitors recently, and at the same time, my current workload has been quite demanding. I’ve been doing my best to stay on top of everything, but I’m worried I won’t be able to complete the project by the deadline without compromising its quality. Would it be possible to request a short extension—maybe just a couple more days? I really want to make sure I deliver something that meets our standards. I appreciate your understanding and support!
situation_zh: 您最近有一些访客，并且您工作很忙，因此您想申请项目延期，该项目将于周五到期。您会对您的经理说什么？
answer_zh: 嗨，我希望你一切顺利。我想和你谈谈本周五到期的项目。最近有一些不速之客来访，同时我目前的工作量也比较大。我一直在尽力掌控一切，但我担心我无法在不影响质量的情况下在截止日期前完成项目。是否可以请求短期延期——也许只是多几天？我真的想确保我交付的东西符合我们的标准。感谢您的理解和支持！

situation: You need to leave work early because you need to drive a family member to see the doctor after going home by taxi ﬁrst. How do you approach your boss Mr.Wang to explain the situation? What speciﬁc points do you include to ensure understanding and approval of your request?
answer: Hi Mr. Wang, I hope it’s okay to interrupt you for a moment. I just wanted to let you know that I need to leave work a bit early today. A family member of mine isn’t feeling well and needs to see a doctor. I’ll be taking a taxi home ﬁrst and then driving them to the clinic. I’ve already ﬁnished most of my urgent tasks, and I’ll make sure to catch up on anything else either later today or ﬁrst thing tomorrow morning. I hope you understand, and thank you so much for your support.
situation_zh: 你需要提前下班，因为你先打车回家后需要载家人去看医生。您如何向您的老板王先生解释情况？为了确保您的请求得到理解和批准，您包括哪些具体要点？
answer_zh: 王先生您好，希望可以打扰您一下。我只是想让你知道我今天需要早点下班。我的一位家人感觉不舒服，需要去看医生。我会先打车回家，然后开车送他们去诊所。我已经完成了大部分紧急任务，我将确保今天晚些时候或明天早上第一件事就赶上其他事情。希望您能理解，也非常感谢您的支持。

situation: You want to ask a neighbor to pick up a package since you won 't be home for an hour.What should you say to your neighbor?
answer: Hi! Sorry to bother you, but I was wondering if you could help me with something. I’m expecting a package to arrive soon, but I won’t be home for about an hour. Would it be possible for you to pick it up for me if it gets delivered while I’m out? I’d really appreciate it, and I can come by to get it as soon as I’m back. Of course, let me know if it’s not convenient —I totally understand. Thanks so much in advance!
situation_zh: 由于您一个小时后才回家，因此您想请邻居来取包裹。您应该对邻居说什么？
answer_zh: 你好！很抱歉打扰您，但我想知道您是否可以帮我做点什么。我预计包裹很快就会到达，但我大约一个小时后才能回家。如果我外出时送货，您可以帮我取吗？我真的很感激，我一回来就可以过来取。当然，如果不方便的话请告诉我——我完全理解。非常感谢！

situation: Your colleague drive to work,but the traﬃc is busy every day, suggest her to take the underground train due to several reasons.
answer: Hey, I noticed you’ve been stuck in traﬃc almost every morning lately—it must be so exhausting. Have you ever thought about taking the underground train instead? It’s usually much faster, especially during rush hour. You wouldn’t have to deal with stressful driving, and you could even relax a bit, maybe listen to music or read something on the way. Plus, it’s often more reliable and better for the environment. I think it might really save you time and energy. Just something to consider—it could make your mornings a lot smoother!
situation_zh: 你的同事开车上班，但每天交通都很繁忙，出于多种原因建议她乘坐地铁。
answer_zh: 嘿，我注意到你最近几乎每天早上都堵车——一定很累吧。您是否考虑过乘坐地铁？通常要快得多，尤其是在高峰时段。您不必应对紧张的驾驶，甚至可以放松一下，也许可以在途中听听音乐或读点东西。此外，它通常更可靠、更环保。我认为这确实可以节省您的时间和精力。只是需要考虑的事情——它可以让你的早晨更加顺利！

situation: Your neighbor invites you and your partner Lee to have dinner and your neighbor is asking you if there is anything you couldn’t eat. Actually your partner Lee is allergic to dairy food because of health issue. What should you say to your neighbor?
answer: Hi, thank you so much for inviting us over for dinner! We’re really looking forward to it. I just wanted to mention that my partner, Lee, has a dairy allergy due to a health condition. So if it’s possible, we’d really appreciate it if the dishes could be dairy-free, or maybe have some options without milk, cheese, or cream. Of course, we totally understand if that’s not convenient—we’ll make sure to bring something along just in case. Thanks again for your kindness, and we’re excited to spend the evening with you!
situation_zh: 你的邻居邀请你和你的伴侣李共进晚餐，你的邻居问你是否有什么不能吃的东西。事实上，你的伴侣李因为健康问题对乳制品过敏。你应该对你的邻居说什么？
answer_zh: 您好，非常感谢您邀请我们共进晚餐！我们真的很期待。我只是想提一下，我的伴侣李由于健康状况对乳制品过敏。因此，如果可能的话，如果菜肴不含乳制品，或者有一些不含牛奶、奶酪或奶油的选择，我们将非常感激。当然，如果不方便，我们完全理解 - 我们会确保携带一些东西以防万一。再次感谢您的好意，我们很高兴能与您共度夜晚！

situation: You will be on a trip and you need your neighbor to help you take care of your plant and water your ﬂowers. You are meeting him in his garden. What should you say to him?
answer: Hey there! I’m going to be away on a short trip for a few days, and I was wondering if you could help me out with something. Would you mind watering my ﬂowers and checking in on my plants while I’m gone? It would really mean a lot to me. They don’t need too much care — just a little water every two or three days, especially the ones on the balcony since they get a lot of sun. I’ll be back on Sunday, and I promise to bring you something nice as a thank-you! Let me know if that’s okay with you.
situation_zh: 您将在旅途中，需要邻居帮助您照顾植物并浇花。你正在他的花园里遇见他。你应该对他说什么？
answer_zh: 嘿！我要去短途旅行几天，我想知道你是否能帮我做点什么。我不在的时候你介意给我的花浇水并检查一下我的植物吗？这对我来说真的意义重大。它们不需要太多的照顾——每两三天浇一点水即可，尤其是阳台上的，因为它们阳光充足。我会在周日回来，我保证会给你带来一些好东西作为感谢！请告诉我您是否同意。

situation: You will go out on holiday and ask your neighbor Monica to help feed the cat for a week.What should you say to her?
answer: Hi Monica! I hope you’re doing well. I just wanted to ask you for a little favor—I 'm going out on holiday next week, and I was wondering if you’d be willing to help me feed my cat while I’m away. It would only be for about a week, and I can leave all the food, bowls, and instructions ready for you. She’s really friendly and low-maintenance—just needs to be fed once a day and maybe a little cuddle if you have time. Of course, I’d really appreciate it and I’ll bring you back a small gift from my trip as a thank-you. Let me know if that works for you!
situation_zh: 你要出去度假，请你的邻居莫妮卡帮忙喂猫一周。你应该对她说什么？
answer_zh: 嗨莫妮卡！我希望你一切都好。我只是想请你帮个小忙——我下周要出去度假，我想知道你是否愿意在我不在的时候帮我喂猫。这只需要大约一周的时间，我可以把所有的食物、碗和说明都准备好给你。她真的很友好，而且不需要太多照顾——每天只需要喂一次饭，如果有时间的话，也许还可以抱抱她。当然，我真的很感激，我会带回我旅行中的小礼物作为感谢。让我知道这是否适合您！

situation: You rented your house to your friend Mr. Harp, and then the furniture broke and you need to tell him. What will you say to him?
answer: Hey Mr. Harp, I hope everything is going well for you. I just wanted to let you know that there was an issue with the furniture in the house. Unfortunately, one of the pieces got broken recently. I know this may be unexpected, but I thought I should inform you as soon as possible so we can ﬁgure out what to do next. Please don’t worry—I’m sure we can sort this out together. If you need any help with repairs, just let me know. Thanks for understanding, and I appreciate your cooperation on this.
situation_zh: 你把房子租给了你的朋友哈普先生，然后家具坏了，你需要告诉他。你会对他说什么？
answer_zh: 嘿，竖琴先生，我希望你一切顺利。我只是想让你知道房子里的家具有问题。不幸的是，其中一块最近坏了。我知道这可能是出乎意料的，但我认为我应该尽快通知您，以便我们确定下一步该做什么。请别担心——我相信我们可以一起解决这个问题。如果您需要任何维修帮助，请告诉我。感谢您的理解，也感谢您对此的合作。

situation: You just moved into a new apartment and you want to invite you sister Maria to come and have a look at it. What will you say to her on the? Or phone to sister for visit new house
answer: Hey Maria, how’s everything going? I hope you 're doing well! I wanted to let you know that I’ve ﬁnally moved into my new apartment, and I’m really excited about it. It’s all set up now, and I thought it would be great if you could come over and have a look at it! I know you’re busy, but maybe you could ﬁnd some time this weekend? I’d love for you to see the place, and it’d be great to catch up as well. Let me know when you’re free—I can’t wait for you to see it!
situation_zh: 你刚刚搬进新公寓，你想邀请妹妹玛丽亚来看看。你会对她说什么？或者打电话给姐姐参观新房
answer_zh: 嘿玛丽亚，一切怎么样？我希望你一切都好！我想让你知道我终于搬进了新公寓，对此我感到非常兴奋。现在一切都准备好了，我想如果你能过来看看就好了！我知道你很忙，但也许这个周末你能抽出时间？我很想让你看看这个地方，如果能赶上的话那就太好了。当你有空时请告诉我——我迫不及待地想让你看到它！

situation: You received an envelope that was not yours, but to a neighbor. You want to return it to your neighbor and what do you want to say?
answer: Hi, I hope you’re doing well! I just wanted to let you know that I received an envelope today that was actually addressed to you. It seems like there was a mix-up, and it ended up at my place instead. I thought I should bring it over right away so you don’t miss it. It looks important, so I didn’t want you to have to deal with any delays. I’ll leave it at your door if you’re not home, or if it’s a good time, I can hand it to you directly. Let me know what works best for you! Hope that helps, and I hope the rest of your day goes smoothly!
situation_zh: 您收到的信封不是您的，而是邻居的。您想将其归还给您的邻居，您想说什么？
answer_zh: 嗨，我希望你一切都好！我只是想让你知道，我今天收到了一个信封，实际上是写给你的。看来是搞混了，最后却到了我家。我想我应该立即把它拿过来，这样你就不会错过它。它看起来很重要，所以我不想让你遇到任何延误。如果你不在家，我会把它放在你家门口，或者如果时间合适，我可以直接交给你。让我知道什么最适合您！希望对您有所帮助，希望您接下来的日子一切顺利！

situation: You want to go to the grocery store during the lunch hour,but it’s raining outside and you didn’t bring an umbrella. You want to borrow an umbrella from your colleague Beth. What would you say to your him?
answer: Hey Beth, I hope you’re doing well today! So, I was planning to head to the grocery store during lunch, but it’s really coming down outside, and unfortunately, I didn’t bring my umbrella with me. I was wondering if I could borrow yours just for a little while? I promise I’ll take good care of it and make sure to return it to you as soon as I get back from the store. I know it’s kind of last-minute, so if it’s not convenient for you, I completely understand. Thanks so much, I really appreciate your help!
situation_zh: 你想在午餐时间去杂货店，但外面下着雨，你没有带伞。你想向你的同事贝丝借一把雨伞。你会对你的他说什么？
answer_zh: 嘿贝丝，我希望你今天一切顺利！所以，我本来打算午餐时去杂货店，但外面真的下雨了，不幸的是，我没有带雨伞。我想知道我是否可以借用你的一段时间？我保证我会妥善保管它，并确保从商店回来后立即将其归还给您。我知道这是最后一刻，所以如果你不方便，我完全理解。非常感谢，非常感谢您的帮助！

situation: You went to watch a movie with a friend, but the car broke down on the way and made my friend wait for a long time.What should you say to your friend?
answer: Hey, I’m so sorry for making you wait for such a long time. The car broke down on the way here, and I was really stuck trying to ﬁgure out what went wrong. I know it must have been frustrating for you, and I feel terrible about it. I should have called you earlier to let you know what was going on. I really appreciate your patience, and I promise I’ll make sure this doesn’t happen again. Let’s still enjoy the movie and make up for the lost time—next time, the movie’s on me!
situation_zh: 你和朋友去看电影，但是途中车子坏了，让我的朋友等了很长时间。你应该对你的朋友说什么？
answer_zh: 嘿嘿，非常抱歉让您久等了。汽车在来这里的路上抛锚了，我真的很想弄清楚到底出了什么问题。我知道这一定让你感到沮丧，我对此感到很糟糕。我应该早点给你打电话让你知道发生了什么事。我真的很感谢您的耐心，我保证我会确保这种情况不再发生。我们还是好好欣赏电影吧，把失去的时间补回来——下次，电影由我来！

situation: You invited friends to have a dinner party, and one of them Tommy oﬀer to bring desserts. You thank him for the oﬀer but you have already prepared enough dessert, so you asked him if he would bring other food to share.
answer: Hey Tommy, thanks so much for oﬀering to bring desserts! That’s really thoughtful of you, and I appreciate it. However, I’ve already prepared plenty of desserts for the dinner, so we’ll have enough sweets for everyone. Would you mind bringing something else to share instead? Maybe some appetizers or a fresh salad, or even a side dish? That way, we’ll have a nice variety of food, and I’m sure everyone will love it. Thanks again for being so helpful! I’m really looking forward to the dinner, and it’s going to be so much fun with all the food we’re bringing!
situation_zh: 您邀请朋友参加晚宴，其中一位汤米提议带甜点。你感谢他的好意，但你已经准备了足够的甜点，所以你问他是否可以带其他食物来分享。
answer_zh: 嘿，汤米，非常感谢你主动带来甜点！你真的考虑得很周到，我很感激。不过，我已经为晚餐准备了很多甜点，所以我们会给大家准备足够的甜点。您介意带一些其他东西来分享吗？也许是一些开胃菜或新鲜的沙拉，甚至是配菜？这样，我们就会有各种各样的食物，我相信每个人都会喜欢它。再次感谢您的帮助！我真的很期待晚餐，我们带来的所有食物都会非常有趣！

situation: You’ve been living in your apartment for a few years and feel that a fresh coat of paint would brighten up the space. You want to ask your landlord for permission to paint the walls yourself. How do you approach this conversation and what speciﬁc points do you bring up to get a positive response?
answer: Hi Mr. Harper, I hope you 're doing well! I 've been living in the apartment for a few years now, and I really enjoy the space. Recently, I’ve been thinking that a fresh coat of paint would really brighten things up and make the apartment feel more refreshed and cozy. I’d love to repaint the walls myself, and of course, I’ll make sure to use neutral colors or any shade you prefer. I’ll also take full responsibility and make sure the job is neat and clean. Would it be alright if I go ahead with it? I think it would make a positive diﬀerence, and I really want to take good care of the place.
situation_zh: 您已经在自己的公寓里住了几年了，觉得刷一层新油漆会让这个空间变得明亮起来。您想请求房东允许您自己粉刷墙壁。您如何进行这次对话？您提出哪些具体观点以获得积极回应？
answer_zh: 哈珀先生，您好，希望您一切顺利！我已经在这套公寓里住了几年了，我真的很喜欢这个空间。最近，我一直在想，刷上一层新油漆确实能让一切变得明亮起来，让公寓感觉更加清新和舒适。我很想自己重新粉刷墙壁，当然，我会确保使用中性颜色或您喜欢的任何颜色。我还将承担全部责任，确保工作整洁干净。如果我继续下去可以吗？我认为这会产生积极的影响，我真的很想好好爱护这个地方。

situation: You didn 't get a taxi, and you want to ask your colleague to give you a ride. What should you say to your colleague?
answer: Hey, I’m really sorry to bother you, but I’ve been trying to get a taxi for the past 20 minutes and just couldn’t get one. It seems like it’s super busy right now or maybe the traﬃc is making it harder for drivers to pick up passengers. Would it be okay if I asked you for a ride, just this once? If you 're heading in the same direction, it would really help me out. Of course, I’m more than happy to chip in for gas or any other cost, and I totally understand if it’s not convenient for you. I wouldn’t ask unless I really had no other option, but I thought I’d check with you before making other plans. Thanks a lot for even considering it—I really appreciate your help!
situation_zh: 你没有打到出租车，你想让你的同事载你一程。你应该对你的同事说什么？
answer_zh: 嘿，真的很抱歉打扰您，过去 20 分钟我一直在尝试打车，但没能打到。现在似乎非常繁忙，或者交通堵塞让司机更难接载乘客。如果我约你搭车，就这一次，可以吗？如果你朝着同一个方向前进，那对我真的很有帮助。当然，我非常乐意支付汽油或任何其他费用，如果这对您来说不方便，我完全理解。除非我真的别无选择，否则我不会问，但我想在制定其他计划之前我会先咨询一下你。非常感谢您考虑这个问题——我真的很感谢您的帮助！

situation: You are late by 10 minutes for a meeting due to a broken car and heavy traﬃc. How do you approach your colleagues or boss to explain your delay? What key points should you mention?
answer: Hi everyone, I’m really sorry for being late to the meeting. I left home early as planned, but unfortunately my car broke down on the way. I had to wait for roadside assistance, and even after that, the traﬃc was unexpectedly heavy due to an accident ahead. I understand that everyone’s time is valuable, and I truly apologize for the delay. Thank you for your patience, and I’ll make sure to catch up quickly and not miss anything important.
situation_zh: 由于汽车故障和交通拥堵，您在会议上迟到了 10 分钟。您如何向同事或老板解释您的延误？您应该提及哪些关键点？
answer_zh: 大家好，非常抱歉开会迟到了。我按计划提前离开家，但不幸的是我的车在半路上抛锚了。我不得不等待路边援助，即使之后，由于前面发生了事故，交通也出乎意料地拥挤。我知道每个人的时间都很宝贵，对于延误我深表歉意。感谢您的耐心等待，我会确保尽快赶上进度，不错过任何重要的事情。

situation: You 've just completed a history assignment and you 're keen on improving it before submission. You decide to seek feedback from your classmate, Ali, who always seems to excel in History. How do you approach Ali for feedback, and what speciﬁc questions do you ask to gain insights on how to enhance your assignment.
answer: Hey Ali, I hope you’re doing well! I’ve just ﬁnished my history assignment and I’m really eager to improve it before I submit it. I know you always do really well in History, so I was wondering if you could take a look at it and give me some feedback. Are there any parts where you think I could add more detail or clarify something? Also, do you think my arguments are well-supported with evidence? I’d love to hear any suggestions you have to make it stronger. Thanks so much for your help—I really appreciate it!
situation_zh: 您刚刚完成了一项历史作业，并且热衷于在提交之前对其进行改进。你决定向你的同学阿里寻求反馈，他似乎在历史方面总是表现出色。您如何向阿里寻求反馈，以及您会提出哪些具体问题来获得有关如何改进您的任务的见解。
answer_zh: 嘿，阿里，我希望你一切都好！我刚刚完成了我的历史作业，在提交之前我真的很渴望改进它。我知道你在历史方面总是做得很好，所以我想知道你是否可以看一下并给我一些反馈。您认为我可以在哪些部分添加更多细节或澄清某些内容吗？另外，您认为我的论点有证据支持吗？我很想听听您提出的任何让它变得更强大的建议。非常感谢您的帮助——我真的很感激！

situation: Your friend invited you to join a sports club. You are interested in the sport but you cannot join in because of family, jobs and you need to travel.What do you say to your friends?
answer: Hey, thank you so much for thinking of me and inviting me to join the sports club! I’ve actually been really interested in the sport, and I’ve heard great things about the club, so it’s deﬁnitely something I would love to try. However, right now I’m juggling a lot of commitments, especially with family responsibilities, work, and some travel coming up. I really wish I could join you, but I just won’t be able to dedicate the time it needs at the moment. I don’t want to join if I can’t fully commit to it. I really appreciate the oﬀer, though, and hopefully, once things settle down a bit, I’ll be able to join in the future. Thanks again for inviting me!
situation_zh: 你的朋友邀请你加入一个体育俱乐部。你对这项运动很感兴趣，但因为家庭、工作和需要旅行而无法参加。你对你的朋友说什么？
answer_zh: 嘿，非常感谢你想到我并邀请我加入体育俱乐部！事实上，我对这项运动非常感兴趣，而且我听说过有关俱乐部的好消息，所以这绝对是我愿意尝试的事情。然而，现在我要兼顾很多事情，尤其是家庭责任、工作和即将到来的旅行。我真的很希望能加入你们，但我现在无法投入所需的时间。如果我不能完全投入，我就不想加入。不过，我真的很感激这个邀请，希望一旦事情稳定下来，我将来就能加入。再次感谢您邀请我！

situation: Your classmate Beth is on vacation and your are at her apartment. The strong wind damaged the furniture on the balcony, so you want to inform your classmates so that she could be mentally prepared.What do you say to her?
answer: Hey Beth, I hope you 're having a great time on your vacation and getting some much- needed rest! I just wanted to let you know that there was a really strong wind today, and unfortunately, some of the furniture on your balcony got damaged. I know this might be a bit worrying, but don’t stress about it too much—everything’s okay. I just wanted to give you a heads-up so you’re mentally prepared when you come back. Once you’re home, we can take a closer look at the damage and ﬁgure out the best way to ﬁx it together. Hope that helps, and enjoy the rest of your trip!
situation_zh: 你的同学贝丝正在度假，你在她的公寓里。大风吹坏了阳台上的家具，所以你想通知你的同学，让她做好心理准备。你对她说什么？
answer_zh: 嘿，贝丝，我希望您在假期中度过愉快的时光并得到一些急需的休息！我只是想让您知道，今天风很大，不幸的是，您阳台上的一些家具被损坏了。我知道这可能有点令人担忧，但不要太紧张——一切都很好。我只是想提醒您一下，以便您回来时做好心理准备。您回家后，我们可以仔细检查损坏情况并找出修复损坏的最佳方法。希望对您有所帮助，祝您旅途愉快！

situation: You 're leading a community book club, and during this month 's meeting, you discover several books are missing from the club 's library. You want to address the issue respectfully, reminding members to return books on time for everyone 's beneﬁt. What would you say to your members?
answer: Hi everyone, I just wanted to bring up a quick reminder. We’ve noticed that a few books from our club library are currently missing, and I wanted to address it with everyone. If you’ve borrowed one and perhaps forgotten to return it, please do bring it back as soon as possible so we can keep the library up-to-date. Returning books on time is really important because it helps everyone in the group enjoy the reading experience, and we can all access the books we need without any delay. I really appreciate your cooperation, and thanks for your understanding and support!
situation_zh: 您领导着一个社区读书俱乐部，在本月的会议期间，您发现俱乐部的图书馆缺少几本书。您希望以尊重的方式解决这个问题，提醒会员按时归还书籍，以造福于每个人。您想对您的会员说些什么？
answer_zh: 大家好，我只是想快速提醒一下。我们注意到我们俱乐部图书馆的一些书籍目前丢失了，我想向大家解决这个问题。如果您借了一本，但可能忘记归还，请尽快归还，以便我们及时更新图书馆的信息。按时归还书籍非常重要，因为这可以帮助小组中的每个人享受阅读体验，并且我们都可以立即获取所需的书籍。衷心感谢您的配合，感谢您的理解和支持！

situation: You borrowed a book from the university library, but while reading it, you notice that two pages has been torn out, but you didn 't do it. What do you say to the librarian when you return the book?
answer: Hello, I’m returning this book. I found two pages torn out while reading. I didn’t do it. I’m really sorry about this. I hope it won’t cause any problems. I can help if there’s anything I need to do. Thank you for your understanding.
situation_zh: 你从大学图书馆借了一本书，但在阅读时，你发现有两页被撕掉了，但你没有这样做。当你还书时，你会对图书管理员说什么？
answer_zh: 你好，我要归还这本书。我在阅读时发现有两页被撕掉。我没有这么做。对此我真的很抱歉。我希望它不会造成任何问题。如果有什么需要我做的，我可以帮忙。感谢您的理解。
